verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server through which an AI assistant can understand the customer schema, build audiences, and create and manage syncs. Its documented example creates a cart-abandoner audience and syncs it to Braze, covering create-to-activate without the dashboard. A REST API with a published OpenAPI spec covers syncs, models, sources and destinations, with API keys that can be scoped for AI tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven audience creation and activation, explicit REST endpoints for audiences, and clear evidence of ad-hoc customer-record querying via MCP beyond schema exploration and performance analysis.
